title: Read-only native pickup/gate sight probe
status: Proposal only; no native execution evidence
commands: lua_run_cl HLOS={p=LocalPlayer()} HLOS.e=LOD.NearLook:Find(HLOS.p,512,function(e) return e:GetClass()=="lod_loot_pickup" end) print("HLOS_TARGET",HLOS.e)

lua_run_cl local f=HLOS if IsValid(f.e) then f.a=f.p:EyePos() f.b=f.e:WorldSpaceCenter() print("HLOS_PICK",f.e:EntIndex(),f.e:GetNW2String("LOD_LootName",""),f.a,f.b,LOD.NearLook:Qualifies(f.p,f.e,512)) end

lua_run_cl local f=HLOS f.ray=function(m) if not f.b then return end local t=util.TraceLine({start=f.a,endpos=f.b,filter=f.p,mask=m}) print("HLOS_RAY",m,t.Hit,t.StartSolid,t.Entity,t.Contents,t.Fraction) end
lua_run_cl for _,m in ipairs({MASK_VISIBLE,MASK_SHOT,MASK_SOLID,MASK_VISIBLE_AND_NPCS}) do HLOS.ray(m) end

lua_run_cl local f=HLOS f.box=function(e) if not f.b then return end local a,b=e:GetCollisionBounds() local h,n,k=util.IntersectRayWithOBB(f.a,f.b-f.a,e:GetPos(),e:GetAngles(),a,b) print("HLOS_BOX",e:EntIndex(),not(h==nil),k) end
lua_run_cl for _,e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("lod_gate")) do if e:GetPos():DistToSqr(HLOS.p:GetPos())<262144 then HLOS.gate(e) HLOS.box(e) end end

lua_run_cl local h=hook.GetTable().HUDPaint.LOD_EquipmentComparison local a=h and debug.getinfo(h,"S") local b=debug.getinfo(LOD.NearLook.Visible,"S") print("HLOS_SRC",a and a.short_src,a and a.linedefined,b.short_src,b.linedefined)
lua_run local p=player.GetHumans()[1] for _,e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("lod_gate")) do if IsValid(p) and e:GetPos():DistToSqr(p:GetPos())<262144 then HLOSS(e) end end
preconditions: One real client is alive near a visibly closed gate while the ordinary white Health pickup label is visible. Keep view/position stationary for the closed/open comparison.
No inventory/player-menu page should be active. Run1-2 and stop unless the actual production-selected entity has label Health and qualifies.
No hardcoded EntIndex is assumed. Record the actual pickup and gate IDs from this run.

stages.result: Snapshot production NearLook target, exact label, pickup ID and frozen eye-to-pickup-center ray.

Client MASK_VISIBLE/SHOT/SOLID/optional NPC variant, hit collider/contents/start-solid/fraction; nearby gate index/open/solid/flags/bounds; independent segment-box intersection; actual hook/function source paths and line numbers.
Server bounds/flags for the same nearby networked gate IDs, using the sole human's stationary position. Compare client/server copies.

After ordinary E opens that gate and the visible opening settles, repeat these commands without reselecting the pickup or replacing the frozen ray. Record the same pickup/gate IDs. Reinitialize if the pickup was removed or viewpoint changed.
Remove diagnostic globals. No hooks, timers, cvars, actors, collision, HUD or feedback events are changed.

expected_identity.target_id: Runtime HLOS_PICK output; not captured in earlier screenshots
expected_identity.gate_id: Runtime HLOS_GATE/HLOS_SG output; the collider hit should match this networked gate ID when it blocks the ray
expected_identity.note: The reusable client presentation model is distinct from the networked gate collider. Do not substitute its client-only model ID for the physical gate ID.

interpretation: Qualifying Health target beyond a closed gate, clear MASK_VISIBLE but MASK_SHOT/SOLID hitting that same gate ID: evidence for a sight-mask mismatch; capture all results before proposing a repair.
All client masks clear but client bounds miss the ray while corresponding server bounds cover it: investigate collider replication/shape, not merely the label formatter.
Client gate box intersects and all masks are clear: inspect solid/contents/flags and an exact server-ray mirror if needed. Pure box intersection alone does not prove native collision admission.

If current rays all hit the closed gate yet the label persists, inspect actual renderer/hook provenance or another producer/stale build. Do not assume the generic NearLook fixture proves native behavior.
If selected target is different, lies in front of the gate, or does not qualify, retain that discrepancy and collect the correct scene before classifying a defect.
Opened gates are expected to stop blocking; their stored geometric bounds can still intersect the ray after solidity is removed.
evidence_output: Printed rows go to the currently running private profile console log identified by its authorized launcher. No game DATA file is created; the helper table contains functions, so retain printed rows rather than serializing the helper.
